sources.title: Safe stopping distance
sources.version: Live guidance; publication date not displayed in inspected passage
sources.locator: Working out your crash avoidance space, steps 1–3; video transcript general-rule explanation
sources.excerpt: count how long it takes you to pass the same object as the vehicle in front of you
sources.supports: Select a fixed roadside point; count three seconds between lead vehicle and own vehicle passing it; increase margins for poor conditions.
sources.fallback_reason: Exact fixed-point/counting instruction not located in targeted TS/TRV or Swedish-agency searches. Trafikverket-hosted NESTA and tunnel reports mention a three-second guideline but do not teach the counting method. Official NSW guidance supplies the exact technique.
sources.scope_limits: Technique only. Three seconds is presented as a guideline, not a Swedish statutory interval or universal guarantee. Australian reaction-time assumptions, long-vehicle laws, penalty rules and left-side placement instructions are not imported.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary page retrieved and inspected

sources.publisher: Department for Infrastructure / Driver & Vehicle Agency, Northern Ireland government
sources.title: Taxi Driver Manual
sources.excerpt: gradually reduce your speed to increase the gap between you and any vehicle ahead
sources.supports: When followed too closely, gradually enlarge the forward gap to allow gentler braking and reduce rear-impact risk.
sources.fallback_reason: Exact increase-forward-gap/gentler-braking behavioural instruction not located in inspected TS/TRV material. This government manual provides the explicit causal advice.
sources.scope_limits: Common defensive-driving advice only, not Northern Ireland taxi law. Risk reduction is not a guarantee; necessary emergency braking remains necessary. Its two-second target is not imported.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary PDF retrieved and inspected

sources.title: KRAV Grundvärden, Vägar och gators utformning (VGU)
sources.version: TRV publication 2024:148, version 1.0; recognised by current Trafikverket VGU overview as part of current framework
sources.locator: Printed p.9(58): braking-distance equation and variable definitions
sources.supports: S_b = (V1² − V2²) / [2g(f_b + i)]; setting final speed to zero and holding denominator constant establishes the speed-squared braking-distance relationship.
sources.scope_limits: Original mathematical derivation from agency equation. Hold grip/braking deceleration and gradient constant; real design friction can depend on speed. No general promise of exact fourfold road-test distance or fourfold total stopping distance.
sources.retrieval_method: Complete indexed primary-PDF equation passage retrieved through search. Direct PDF opens timed out; no local source download or checksum claimed.

claims.required_statement_to_verify: Teach selecting a fixed point and counting the time between both vehicles passing it.

source_searches.finding: General stopping-distance background and direct VGU braking equation found. No exact fixed-point method or tailgater/forward-gap instruction located; this describes the inspected search coverage, not all publications.

No exact directly published method located. Public-service media quote a police officer and parliamentary motions mention the rule, but these were not selected instead of a direct government teaching source.
Supports reaction + braking distinction and conditions affecting stopping; does not explicitly state the squared-speed relation. Kept as inspected background, not an added duplicate citation.

swedish_rule_check.excerpt: Avståndet till ett framförvarande fordon skall anpassas
swedish_rule_check.finding: The general Swedish following-distance duty requires adaptation to avoid rear collision on slowing/stopping, without specifying a fixed three-second interval.
